$comment: Sort UI 2.0 Context Menu (page 161:1174) demos "Photo" and "Chat message": the Dropdown Menu Content instances, cropped to the menu's own 224 px box from get_screenshot renders of their _Component Preview (1490:65635, 1490:65640; Figma's export adds the outside border and the shadow's margin). renderers/context-menu.tsx renders the same items in an open DropdownMenuContent, which is what ContextMenu shows at the pointer. entries.$why: The reactions are emoji: Figma renders Apple Color Emoji, the browser its own emoji font, so pixels cannot match; the spec check compares the menu, the row and the 32 px reaction items.
